lastCompletedStory.title: Wire cam-spawned phases (orchestrator, implementer, reviewer) to use configured --model

nextStoryContext: US-002 is complete. The three cam-spawned claude processes (orchestrator in run.ts, implementer in worker-argv.ts via loop.ts, reviewer in review.ts) now pass --model <value> from readPhaseModel(phase). Each builder has model?: string optional; defaults to DEFAULTS[phase] (constant, no I/O) when absent; callers pass readPhaseModel(phase) for production config reads. Three new oracle test files cover the wiring. US-003 is next: the cam config Ink menu to choose model per phase + backend, persisting to project.toml.

officialDocsValidated.summary: --model flag confirmed: accepts full model name (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6) or alias (sonnet, opus). Our usage of full names like claude-opus-4-8 and claude-sonnet-4-6 matches the documented form exactly.
